originalAuthoredFriend.headline: {{personPreferredName}} may be giving away the quiet part of the day before it has even started.
originalAuthoredFriend.body: {{personPreferredName}} may wake up, reach for the phone, and start answering messages before anyone has asked for an immediate response.
